notes:
Achievement popups ✿
• Hanami now has its own Xbox-style achievement popup, with the gamerscore you just earned, and a special one with a petal burst when you get a platinum
• While Hanami is open, Steam's own popups and sounds stay quiet, so you only see Hanami's. Your Steam settings come back exactly as they were when Hanami closes
• Choose in Settings → Achievements: all of Steam's popups off, just achievement popups off, or leave Steam alone. There's a Preview button too
• Steam games: popups appear the moment you unlock something. This uses Hanami's Steam connection (Settings → Silent installs)
• War for Cybertron: popups come from Hanami once WFC updates to 1.0.1, which turns the game's own popup off when Hanami launches it
